world_map.lore: Karn Ashur, the Temple of the First Flame: claimed by none of the five successor states. The Ashen Order keeps the flame on the higher western peak and Al-Mirah's spring at its foot. "The Temple of the First Flame: temple-city on the great peak, Al-Mirah's spring at its foot, a flame at the summit; seat of the Ashen Order and its Library." (atlas_data.json) About 500,000 people live in the basin city and about 300,000 more across the High Dunes valleys (the brief).
